page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes, and no text below the column except the catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: tem venit, cum in Doctora-tus, ut nũc loquimur, hono-re capiendo iussus sum in folio confidere, pileoque impo-sito, quasi libertate accepta, annulo aureo insignitus, potestatem aperiendi claudendique libri accepi. Quod autem de professione paulo ante dicebamus, idem alio eiusdem Orationis loco perspicuè confirmatur, ubi sua in potestate positum esse praedicat, sese Iurisconsultū pro-fiteri: Itaque, inquit, si mihi » homini uehementer occu-» pato stomachum moueritis, » triduò me Iurisconsultum es-» se profitebor. Eòdemque il-la

page.notes: Running head is set in a heavy, decorative type with blackened letters and could not be read. The line beginning "tem venit" is a continuation from the previous page. The » marks at the start of the lines are quotation marks in the printed text and are kept where they stand. The text ends with the hyphenated word "il-" and the catchword "la" at the foot.
